title: Initial child-endangering charges against four Siders defendants

data.claim: Gary Siders Jr., Elizabeth Siders, Gary Siders Sr., and Christina Siders were each charged with 16 counts of endangering children, a second-degree felony, following the June 30, 2026 Hamden search and rescue.
data.adjudication: pending-adjudication; defendants reported as pleading not guilty
